title.zh: 【Nillion L2 将停止运行，持有 NIL 或 ETH 的用户需迁移资产】
title.en: 【Nillion L2 将停止运行，持有 NIL 或 ETH 的用户需迁移资产】

current_state.zh: Nillion has announced that its L2 network will cease operations, instructing users holding NIL or ETH to migrate their assets to Ethereum mainnet through the official cross-chain bridge.
current_state.en: Nillion has announced that its L2 network will cease operations, instructing users holding NIL or ETH to migrate their assets to Ethereum mainnet through the official cross-chain bridge.
